text:
alen_cs: FYI - Botanica.ai (trial) asked for Brazil-region peering + demo allowlist for a 3-day proof-of-concept. They want header pin and a temporary soft QPS bump. Can we triage?

marta_ops: Hosted API or Dedicated? Need CIDRs, demo window, and expected QPS.

alen_cs: Hosted. Contact: hola@botanica.ai. Window: 2026-07-14 09:00 -> 2026-07-16 23:59 BRT. Sustained ~140 QPS, occasional demo spikes to 520 for up to 10m. CIDRs provided: 52.23.0.0/16 and 2001:0db8:feed::/48. Header pin: X-Org: botanica-pilot.

raj_netops: Edge can do v4+v6 allowlist and header equality check. Recommend feature-flagged route + canary rollout (2% -> 25 -> 100). Suggest auto-revoke after 2026-07-17. We also need a peering ticket for sa-east1.

tiago_pm: Renewal conversation in August; this pilot could shift them toward Dedicated. Capture daily feedback and include an eval set.

marta_ops: Risk note - 520 burst QPS from trial can increase token burn. Propose billing cap $1,800 for window, enable prefix caching, and an emergency manual throttle cmd. Also add a post-demo usage snapshot for CS billing.

raj_netops: Proxy snippet for ops team:
```
allowlist_ips: ["52.23.0.0/16","2001:0db8:feed::/48"]
header_whitelist: ["X-Org"]
region_route: "sa-east1"
rate_limit_override: { "sustained_qps": 140, "burst_qps": 520, "burst_window_sec": 600 }
auto_revoke: true
```
We'll validate header equality only; HMAC would need extra lambda.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-2555 - "Botanica.ai sa-east1 peering + demo QPS bump". Owners: marta_ops, raj_netops.

marta_ops: I'll draft the customer acceptance + data handling consent and confirm they agree to the $1,800 cap. Also confirm CIDRs and that they accept auto-revoke.

tiago_pm: I'll prepare an eval checklist: p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, routing correctness, header mismatches, error spikes, and a short feedback survey for the customer. Attach results to CS-2555.

raj_netops: Plan: today validate CIDRs and consent; T+1 create canary 2%; T+2 ramp to 25% if green, then start demo window on 2026-07-14. Add an emergency throttle runbook entry: `rb throttle cs-2555 --qps 80`.

marta_ops: Assignments: marta (customer comms + billing cap + consent), raj (edge + peering + runbook), tiago (eval + renewal notes). I'll update CS-2555 with timeline and calendar events.

alen_cs: One more ask from customer - can we support a short-lived X-Trace header for routing confirmation? They want to see which edge served requests.

raj_netops: We can echo X-Trace at the edge for demo only. Will include it in canary. Remove after window.

ops-bot: Calendar event CS-2555-demo created for 2026-07-14T12:00Z. Auto-revoke reminder set for 2026-07-17T02:00Z.

marta_ops: Closing loop - once canary is green, we'll request the customer's go/no-go and proceed. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
